## About
King Mechanical LLC is a licensed air conditioning and heating contractor serving greater Phoenix and the surrounding areas. We install, service and repair systems for homes and businesses, and we work on all makes and models.
Our reputation is based on service, safety, and quality, regardless of how large or small the job. Customers tell us they like that Frank gives a fair price up front, and that the crew shows up on time and keeps them informed from start to finish.
We're rated 4.8 from 78 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Air Conditioning and Heating Installation: Package units, split systems, gas and electric systems, and evaporator coolers.
- Service & Repair: We service all makes and models: system diagnostics, coil cleaning, thermostat replacement, run capacitor replacements, and fan and blower motor replacements.
- Seasonal Tune-Up: A unit inspection and a condensation drain line flush to keep your system ready for the season.
- Duct Work Modification and Design Build: Custom-made ductwork, layout design, and layout redesign for increased efficiency.
- Commercial and Residential HVAC: Heating and cooling work for homes and for businesses.

## FAQ
Q: What brands do you work on?
A: All makes and models, including Trane, Carrier, Goodman, Heil and York.

Q: Which cities do you serve?
A: Phoenix, Ahwatukee, Apache Junction, Avondale, Buckeye, Carefree, Casa Grande, Cave Creek, Chandler, El Mirage, Fountain Hills, Gilbert, Glendale, Goodyear, Laveen, Litchfield Park, Mesa, Paradise Valley, Peoria, Scottsdale, Sun City, Surprise, Tempe, Tolleson and Queen Creek. Additional cities can be serviced, so just ask.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you have any thermostat specials?
A: Yes. Ask about a free Nest thermostat with a qualifying purchase.
